Subject: Quiet launch: manager calibration & staggered handoffs for review window

Team —

We need to run a limited "quiet launch" for the annual review window the week of Nov 16 before we open the full cycle. Objective: validate sensitive-role handoffs, confirm manager calibration messaging, and exercise our private routing for privileged data. This is not the org-wide launch — it’s targeted to engineering managers in three pods + one small infra team.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Nov 9: managers receive calibration checklist + manager training 30-min drop-in (opt-in).
- Nov 12: secure handoff of privileged-role review packets to HR liaisons (encrypted upload to PeopleOps portal).
- Nov 16: quiet launch opens to selected managers; monitor for policy exceptions/EScalations for 72 hrs.
- Nov 19: summarize findings, roll forward fixes into full launch (target Nov 23).

Key asks for today:
1) Karthik — confirm that canary for privileged-role approvals and staggered routing is ready on Dedicated by Nov 9.
2) Laura — review the manager comm draft and flag anything that could leak role-change hints; keep messaging high-level.
3) Priyom — assign 2 CS liaisons to handle manager queries; capture repeat questions into a quick FAQ.

Attached: manager-calibration-checklist-v1.xlsx (tracking + must-sign items) and quiet-launch-email-draft.md (manager-facing email). I’m copying Emma from our PeopleOps partner to confirm upload instructions and encryption options for the handoff.

I’ll follow up with a short tally meeting Wed Nov 11 (15m).

Thanks —
Vivek

Vivek — thanks for the plan. A few suggested edits after skimming the comm draft:

1) Tone: we must avoid language that hints at promotions/role changes during quiet launch. Replace any uses of "role-alignment" with "performance calibration".
2) Staggering: for teams with privileged access (infra, SRE, security), recommend a 48-hour stagger between when they receive the packet and when they submit final ratings to minimize simultaneous access to audit logs.
3) Manager checklist: add a single checkbox for managers to confirm they have spoken privately with any impacted ICs before submitting ratings. It should be required for privileged roles.

Also — flagged two small items in the checklist (rows 7 and 12) that reference an older PeopleOps upload path. Please point to the portal link (shared below) and confirm encryption instructions with Emma.

Laura
